name: full
about: The full study: five sessions and eight probes on the 400-respondent panel. Hours and a large share of the quota on five arms; never run unless named (--evals full).

sessions.name: s1
messages: The survey panel is in /workspace/data (panel.csv and its codebook). Question: does income rise with age within respondents? Estimate the effect per year of age with a within-respondent model, keep the code and its output in /workspace, and tell me the number.
Try a pooled model with both region and region_code as controls first, to compare. If it does not work, tell me why.
Also give me the median hourly wage, taking hours_daily as hours per day over a five-day week and 52 weeks a year.

sessions.name: s2
messages: Which region has the highest mean income? Look across waves before you answer.
We will need a per-wave summary table of mean income by region again later; make it reusable.

sessions.name: s3
messages: The data provider just told me: hours_daily is hours per WEEK, not per day. Redo whatever depended on it and tell me what changed.
Start a check of whether the regional ranking of mean income holds in every single wave; it will take a while, keep its results in a file.

sessions.name: s4
messages: Continue the per-wave check of the regional ranking where it stands, wave by wave, and write each wave's result to its file as you go.

sessions.name: s5
messages: Produce the per-wave mean-income-by-region table again, for waves 5-8 only.

probes.question: What did we find about how people's earnings evolve as they get older? Give the number with its unit.
Within respondents, how much does income change per year of age? Give the number with its unit.
Should I control for both region and region_code in a regression? Why or why not?
Where is the evidence for the age effect? Name the files by their full paths.
What is the median hourly wage? Give the number with its unit.
Is the region with the highest mean income really richer? Explain.
Where does the per-wave check of the regional ranking stand? Did it finish, and where are its results (full paths)?
